item.description: The Switch class implementation has incorrect handling of case tuples, causing test failures. The test expects OrderedDict([(('',), ())]) != ((('',), [], None),) which suggests mismatch in how cases are stored and compared.
item.contract: The Switch constructor should properly process case tuples and store them in a format compatible with test expectations. Cases should be stored as tuples of keys and statements, where keys can be None, strings, or integers, and statements should be properly formatted.

item.description: Multiple Switch test cases are failing due to improper case handling, particularly around empty cases and default cases.
item.contract: The Switch class should correctly handle cases with empty keys (None), string keys, integer keys, and multiple keys, storing them in the expected tuple format for comparison.

item.description: There are issues with the internal representation of switch cases, particularly in how keys are processed and stored.
item.contract: The internal representation of cases should be consistent with the expected format from the test cases. Keys should be properly converted to binary string representations and stored as tuples.

item.description: Some test failures are due to incorrect parsing of case keys, particularly when dealing with zero-width values and enum cases.
item.contract: Switch case key processing should correctly handle zero-width values and enum values by converting them to appropriate binary representations.

item.description: Missing or incorrect handling of case source locations that leads to test failures with specific error patterns.
item.contract: The Switch class should properly handle case source locations when provided, ensuring consistency with test expectations.
